comment: Written against the v2.47.0 release commit 4588d09, the installed build. Three parameters have no widget on the panel and so carry no line and no tag: Snap and Clock division, which were knobs in an earlier version and are now reached only through the module menu, and Lane, which the lane tabs in the display set. The curve editor, the ruler, the loop handle and the lane tabs are one display widget with no ParamWidget per control, so their gestures are written as notes. The panel prints REC twice, on the record input jack and on the arm button.
